context: Reuse registry support_status and corpus-inventory.json. Do not invent a second taxonomy. CLI honesty is already merged (#1771); remaining surface is README (and any user-facing docs list that duplicates it).
description:
Original customer-value step 8. README leads with 51 platform metadata entries. The registry already has support_status (stable=5, beta=28, experimental=17, deprecated=1) and public-contracts.md defines those terms. PR #1771 added a CLI Support column separate from Driver availability. The README list still reads like a support claim, and no published corpus bundle exists for any warehouse.

Required: put the support tier next to each public platform name, and mark platforms with zero published corpus results as unproven. Do not wait on live Snowflake/Databricks runs to tell the truth about what has never been published.

anti_patterns.dont: duplicate a second support taxonomy in README prose
anti_patterns.why: public-contracts.md and the registry already define support_status

anti_patterns.dont: wait for live Snowflake results before labeling the README
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD mark them unproven from corpus-inventory.json now

preserves.behavior: Do not change support_status enum or counts except by regenerating from the registry
Do not claim live cloud results that are not in the corpus

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.platform_registry import iter_platforms; from collections import Counter; print(Counter(p.support_status for p in iter_platforms()))'
verifications.description: README support counts match the registry
Corpus-unproven warehouses are labeled in README
verifications.expected: warehouse names are not presented as proven

work_units.evidence: README SQL/DataFrame lists grouped by registry support_status
work_units.summary: README platform list shows support_status next to each name, matching the registry

work_units.evidence: Snowflake, Databricks SQL, Google BigQuery marked unproven; corpus-proven names unlabeled
work_units.summary: Mark platforms with zero results-data/corpus-inventory.json bundles as unproven

work_units.evidence: uv run -- benchbox platforms list still prints Driver and Support columns (benchbox/cli/platform.py; #1771)
work_units.summary: Confirm benchbox platforms list still shows Support separately from Driver
